data: What is the macro-label of the x-axis?

The x-axis represents the number of workers per "expert". The y-axis shows Cohen's kappa values. The caption mentions that the figure shows the agreement for stance annotation on 98 comments. The legend indicates different thresholds for MACE. The x-axis is labeled "Workers per 'expert'". Therefore, the macro-label of the x-axis is "Workers per 'expert'".
